ai_language_tip: Speak polite standard Indonesian (id) with Bapak/Ibu; Jakarta staff mix in casual Betawi/English words; English works at international hotels, private hospitals and Bali tourist venues.
english_ok: sometimes — Common at international hotels, private hospitals, Jakarta offices and Bali; limited at warung, bengkel, markets and government offices.
politeness: Polite and indirect: greet with selamat pagi/siang/sore/malam, use Bapak/Ibu, soften requests with 'mohon' or 'boleh'; thank with terima kasih.
name_tip: Many Indonesians have a single name or no family name; address by Bapak/Pak or Ibu/Bu + first name ('Pak Budi'); book under the name the person uses + WhatsApp number.
phone_tip: Mobile starts 08 and has 10–13 digits (0812-1234-5678); Jakarta landline 021-1234-5678; the mobile is usually the WhatsApp number; read back in groups of 4.
time_tip: CRITICAL: 'setengah delapan' = 7:30 (half before eight)! 'jam 7 kurang seperempat' = 6:45; written time uses a dot (19.30); add pagi/siang/sore/malam.
number_tip: Read digits singly; prices in rupiah use dots as thousand separators and 'rb'/'ribu' or 'k' (50 rb = 50.000); 'jt' = juta (million).
avoid_calling: Avoid Friday 11:30–13:30 (Jumat prayer), lunch rush 12:00–13:00, calls after 21:00, Ramadan buka puasa time (sunset), and the Lebaran/cuti bersama week when many small shops close.
closed_days: Office weekend is Sat–Sun; most shops and malls open daily; Lebaran (Idul Fitri) plus cuti bersama closes small shops and warung for several days; Nyepi closes almost everything in Bali for a day.
booking_channels: WhatsApp is the default for restaurants, salons, clinics and tradesmen; Halodoc and hospital apps/WhatsApp for doctors; GoFood/GrabFood/ShopeeFood for delivery; Gojek/Grab for rides; Tokopedia/Shopee for shopping.
voice_menu: Telcos (Telkomsel, Indosat), banks, PLN electricity and BPJS use IVR menus; hospitals have call centres; small shops answer directly or via WhatsApp.
callback_habits: Businesses usually reply and confirm on WhatsApp (often a WhatsApp Business auto-reply first); hospitals send WhatsApp reminders; couriers phone or WhatsApp on the day.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 峇里島與龍目島的潛水、浮潛、火山日出團多 WhatsApp 預約並含飯店接送；國家公園門票多線上購買。

may_come_up.what: Sunrise trek includes hotel pickup at a fixed early hour
Group price requires a minimum number of pax

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport number for park tickets

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊、美甲、按摩多用 WhatsApp 預約，連鎖店有 App；部分女性顧客會要求女性美髮師或女性專用沙龍。

may_come_up.what: Muslimah salon accepts women only
Hair colouring price depends on hair length

sensitive_asked.what: Asks a selfie or ID photo for a salon booking

usually_asked: Treatment: creambath, potong, smoothing, nail art

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消多在 WhatsApp 對話處理；Mobile JKN 的取號可在 App 內取消後重取；訂金（DP）臨時取消通常不退。

may_come_up.what: Mobile JKN queue can be cancelled and retaken in the app
DP is forfeited for same-day cancellation

sensitive_asked.what: Asks booking code (kode booking) and NIK

usually_asked: Name and WhatsApp used for booking
Kode booking if from an app

clinic.before_dialing_zh: BPJS 健保病人用 Mobile JKN App 取號，到醫院（FKRTL）前須有初級醫療（Faskes 1）轉診單；自費病人可用醫院 App、WhatsApp 或 Halodoc 預約。

may_come_up.what: BPJS patients must take a queue number in Mobile JKN with a referral
Private hospital doctor schedule changes; WhatsApp confirms the day before

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NIK, BPJS card number or medical record number

usually_asked: BPJS or umum (self-pay) or private insurance
Patient's name and date of birth
Check-in at the hospital about one hour early for BPJS

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、電力（PLN）與 BPJS 客服有語音選單，帳戶事項須本人以 NIK 驗證。

may_come_up.what: Bank says account matters need the account holder

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NIK, mother's maiden name or OTP

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 行政手續多走線上入口或到場辦理（如 Dukcapil 戶政）；學校可電話或 WhatsApp 詢問，週末不接。

may_come_up.what: Population office handles KTP and KK in person or online by region

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 冷氣清洗、水電與清潔多用 WhatsApp 或 App 叫；地址要含 RT/RW、村里（kelurahan）與社區名稱。

may_come_up.what: AC service priced per unit and PK size
Housing complex security asks the worker to leave ID at the gate

sensitive_asked.what: Asks transfer before the technician comes

usually_asked: Job type and number of AC units (PK)
Address with perumahan, blok, RT/RW, kelurahan

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 連鎖飯店多經 Traveloka、tiket.com、Agoda，民宿與 guesthouse 常 WhatsApp；入住需 KTP 或護照。

may_come_up.what: Check-in requires KTP or passport
Villa in Bali asks a deposit for damage

sensitive_asked.what: Asks a photo of KTP or passport in advance

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間、開齋節與集體休假（cuti bersama）是否營業、是否清真、可否 QRIS 付款、有無停車位。

may_come_up.what: Explains which days the shop closes over Lebaran
Says whether QRIS and debit cards are accepted

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫診所與寵物美容（grooming）多 WhatsApp 預約，貓的服務最多；寵物旅館要疫苗紀錄。

may_come_up.what: Grooming price differs for long-hair cats
Pet hotel requires vaccination record

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full prepayment to an individual account for boarding

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多看 Rumah123、OLX、Mamikos（分租房 kos），房東與仲介習慣 WhatsApp 約看房；租約常一次付一年。

may_come_up.what: Agent continues on WhatsApp
Rent paid yearly up front for houses

sensitive_asked.what: Asks a booking fee before any viewing

usually_asked: Number of occupants, couple or single

repair.before_dialing_zh: 機車與汽車修理行（bengkel）多直接到場或電話詢問；原廠保養可用品牌 App 或 WhatsApp 預約。

may_come_up.what: Dealer books servis berkala by kilometre through its app or WhatsApp
Bengkel quotes only after inspection

usually_asked: Motor or car model and plat nomor

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 印尼餐廳多用 WhatsApp 或電話訂位，大桌、包廂與齋戒月開齋（buka puasa）時段要提早，常先付訂金（DP）；會問是否需要清真菜。

may_come_up.what: Buka puasa slots in Ramadan need a DP transfer to secure the table
WhatsApp Business auto-reply sends the menu and booking form first
Answers whether the kitchen is halal-certified

sensitive_asked.what: Asks a DP to the restaurant's bank account under the caller's name

usually_asked: Date and time written with a dot (19.30)
Smoking or non-smoking area, indoor or outdoor
Halal menu or minimum spend for a private room

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕、便當盒（nasi kotak）、生日米塔（tumpeng）與開齋節禮盒（hampers）常 WhatsApp 下單並付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Nasi kotak or tumpeng orders need a minimum quantity and DP

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full payment to a different name than the shop

usually_asked: Menu choice and budget per box

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 小吃與餐廳可 WhatsApp 點餐自取（bungkus），外送以 GoFood、GrabFood、ShopeeFood 為主；常問辣度與要不要加飯。

may_come_up.what: Warung says delivery only via GoFood or GrabFood
Payment by QRIS at pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Asks transfer to a personal account before cooking a small bungkus order

tracking.before_dialing_zh: JNE、J&T、SiCepat、Pos Indonesia 多用官網、App 或 WhatsApp 官方帳號以運單號（resi）查件。

may_come_up.what: Courier WhatsApp bot answers with the resi number

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the OTP to change the delivery address

usually_asked: Address with kecamatan and kode pos

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車以 Gojek、Grab 為主，機車計程（ojek）最常用；機場接送與包車（sewa mobil + sopir）可 WhatsApp 預約。

may_come_up.what: Suggests GoRide/GoCar or Grab for city trips
Car with driver priced per 12 hours, fuel and tolls extra or not

sensitive_asked.what: Self-drive rental asks KTP and SIM (driving licence)

usually_asked: Pax and luggage, MPV or sedan
